actual_scope: Combine complemented rotation and disjoint prime-block rotations to prove smaller ordinary Stein generator bounds for homogeneous tensor blocks and inverses. Prove the exact necklace cycle product, an absolute correction bound and a Bertrand family with superpolynomial-in-d savings; preserve all transport, materialization, precision and source-admission limits.
scope_change_reason: After independent verification of the complemented-rotation theorem, the orchestrator identified a stronger unequal-cycle construction. Pairwise coprime prime block periods allow exact product counts and remove the even-n/centrosymmetry requirement. This wave is combined with the unpublished prior wave into one contribution; the frozen earlier artifact remains intact.

stop_rule: Stop after independent review and exact verification of the two orbit constructions, stated elementary prime family and honest transport/materialization/precision costs. Do not optimize prime selection, claim an all-order minimum, infer runtime/kappa improvement, or silently assume actual source blocks are matched.
